note: Committed half of the provenance ledger. Private sources are not here: Continuum is public, so a private repository is named by an uncommitted overlay (see reference/parity-ledger-overlay.example.json). docs/parity-ledger.md is the human account of the same classifications and tests/test_parity_ledger.py asserts the two agree.

sources.note: The parent automation repository the parity sweep in kodmial/runtime-lab#59 audited. Public, so it is read with the ambient read-only token.

paths.note: kodmial/runtime-lab#99 write-back: Continuum's agent plane writes only to a branch on the repository it was dispatched against, so there is no second repository for it to write back into.
kodmial/runtime-lab#23 lossless publication: absorbed by .github/scripts/agent_workspace.py, which materializes the workspace tree with git commit-tree.
kodmial/runtime-lab#136 point-of-use identity: absorbed by .github/scripts/opencode_runtime.py, which re-checks the resolved binary digest immediately before each invocation.
kodmial/runtime-lab#143 trust boundary: absorbed by .github/scripts/trust_policy.py and the authorize/gate job split.
Exact-artifact delivery, whose portable form Continuum already ships.
kodmial/runtime-lab#145 repair lock with a release path: absorbed by the age check and conflict-bounds budget in .github/workflows/consumer-repair.yml.
Publication and idempotence (kodmial/runtime-lab#23, #131) are properties Continuum holds in its own agent workflows.
The consumer's own two-toggle configuration. An advance here is that repository's business; this file exists to be edited by whoever owns the consumer.
Per-issue experiment records. These advance on every issue and would otherwise make the checker unignorable.
The parent repository's own knowledge store and sync automation, which Continuum does not mirror.
Benchmark output for that repository's own qualification harness.

incidents.note: Lossless agent publication: the work reaches a pull request without being guessed at, re-derived, or dropped. Branch derived from the issue number, provenance proven by candidate refs, change materialized by git commit-tree.
First half of kodmial/runtime-lab#99. Continuum's agent plane writes only to a branch on the repository it was dispatched against, so the mechanism the report asks for would have nothing to point at.

Second half of kodmial/runtime-lab#99, split because two reports share that number. The property a push must not silently overwrite a moved target is enforced by --force-with-lease and by the immutable release-tag input. The mechanism differs; the property does not.

Publication idempotence: open pull requests are queried in --state open before anything is published, so a re-dispatched run finds the existing pull request. Absorbed rather than must-port because it is a consequence of the recovery path implemented for #23.

Point-of-use OpenCode identity. $GITHUB_PATH appends while PATH resolution takes the first match, so an earlier entry providing a file called opencode would run instead of the verified binary with every digest check still green.

Trust boundary around the privileged agent job: a separate authorize job resolves the dispatching credential, the agent keeps git * denied, and the model produces a commit and a pull request body rather than performing either.

Repair lock with a release path. A dispatched repair that was cancelled, timed out, or wedged left the label behind and every later failure re-entered the step, saw the label, and exited. Closed by an age check on the lock, with an unreadable age treated as held.
